names: UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision
UCSF School of Dentistry and Interprofessional Education Center
summary: Three buildings tracked as one combined record (the two mapped footprints share DataSF Building Footprints id SF3940003, whose parcels are addressed 409 and 499 Illinois St; which footprint is 490 Illinois St is unresolved): UCSF's Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision, a 347,500-sq-ft, 12-story eye-care tower at 490 Illinois Street that SF YIMBY reported open on November 27, 2020, at a reported cost of about $237 million (SmithGroup architect); 499 Illinois Street, a 6-story biotechnology building (its structural engineer describes a 500,000 sq ft center in two buildings) completed 2008 and owned by Alexandria Real Estate Equities until UCSF bought it; and 409 Illinois Street, which Alexandria also owned and which UCSF bought together with 499 Illinois St for $767,000,000 in December 2025 and is renovating into its new School of Dentistry and an Interprofessional Education Center, targeted to open in late 2029.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200607186938 filed to erect the 6-story medical research and biotechnical research facility at 499 Illinois St

UC Regents approve a $237,000,000 project budget and design for UCSF's new Center for Vision Neurosciences building at Mission Bay -- referred to in UCSF's own campus numbering as 'Block 33' (a different numbering system from the OCII plan-block numbers used elsewhere in this repo; see open_questions), combining the Department of Ophthalmology and the Francis I. Proctor Foundation in a 12-story tower with a 5-story south wing and 3-story north wing; construction was expected to begin June 2017 with completion targeted for July 2019
SF YIMBY reports (2020-11-27) that UCSF's Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois Street has opened; the exact opening date is not given

The University of California (UC Regents) buys 409 Illinois St and 499 Illinois St together from Alexandria Real Estate Equities for $767,000,000: approximately 525,421 rentable sq ft on 3.6 acres with a 587-space shared garage. UC's own CEQA Notice of Exemption for the acquisition (Class 1, Existing Facilities) was posted the next day.

UC files a separate CEQA Notice of Exemption for an "Advanced Work Phase" at 409/499 Illinois St -- site preparation and make-ready construction elements ahead of the main renovation, also a Class 1 exemption.

Renovation of 409 Illinois St begins: 261,117 gross sq ft converted into UCSF's new School of Dentistry and Interprofessional Education Center (dentistry, medicine, nursing, pharmacy and physical therapy). Suffolk (contractor) and CO Architects (architect) selected via progressive design-build; Construction Dive reports a project cost of about $278,000,000.
Completion targeted for late 2029 for UCSF's School of Dentistry and Interprofessional Education Center at 409 Illinois St.

facts.value: 490 Illinois St (Valley Center for Vision): SmithGroup. 409 Illinois St renovation (School of Dentistry / Interprofessional Education Center): CO Architects, with Suffolk as design-build contractor.

490 Illinois St: 347,500 across three separate buildings (12-story tower, 5-story south wing, 3-story north wing) plus ~75,000 sq ft of parking for 200+ vehicles. 499 Illinois St: six stories per its 2006 DBI permit (its structural engineer, SGH, describes two five-story buildings over two levels of parking); size reported variously -- SGH: a 500,000 sq ft center in two buildings; SF Standard (2025): 409 and 499 together add up to 470,000 sq ft. 409 and 499 Illinois St combined (per UC's own Dec 2025 acquisition filing): ~525,421 rentable sq ft on 3.6 acres with a 587-space shared garage. 409 Illinois St's renovation into the School of Dentistry / Interprofessional Education Center is 261,117 gross sq ft.

490 Illinois St: opened for the University of California, San Francisco (SF YIMBY); fundraising led by the nonprofit That Man May See. 499 Illinois St: owned by Alexandria Real Estate Equities (its 2013 release calls it 'Alexandria's 499 Illinois Street'; sold to UC in Dec 2025 per SF Standard); no source read states who developed it.

409 Illinois St: 3940003. 499 Illinois St: 3940005 per DataSF's current Assessor parcel data (queried 2026-09-28) -- differs from the block/lot 001 the 2006 building permit used and the lot 004 an earlier source in this file cites; the Assessor's own lot numbering for this address has clearly changed more than once and is not fully reconciled here (see open_questions). 490 Illinois St's own blklot was not re-confirmed in this pass.

open_questions: MERGED 2026-09-22: this record combines the former mission_bay_490_illinois and mission_bay_499_illinois records, matching the geometry files' own 2026-09-22 merge (data/manual/mission_bay_490_499_illinois.geojson) -- both buildings share one DataSF Building Footprints mblr (SF3940003) and are described together as a connected 490-499 Illinois campus in commercial listings. UCSF's own occupancy at 499 Illinois St (leased, then purchased) versus outright ownership at 490 Illinois St is not distinguished by a source found in this pass.

Exact opening day within November 2020 (490 Illinois) is not given by the source found; only the month is confirmed. Exact month/day of the 2008 completion (499 Illinois) is likewise not sourced, only the year.

The 2006 construction permit's own block/lot for 499 Illinois St (block 3940, lot 001) differs from the lot the Assessor now uses for this address (lot 004); the address, biotechnical/medical-research-facility description, 6 stories, and $90M cost all line up with this parcel, so this is treated as a lot renumbering, not a different building. The permit's own completion sign-off (2009-04-06) also runs slightly later than the Assessor's 2008 year, which may reflect a lag between substantial completion and permit closeout.

2026-09-21 pass: found the January 26, 2017 Regents budget/design approval item for 490 Illinois St (UCSF calls it 'Block 33' in its own campus numbering -- assumed at the time to be a coincidental name collision with this project's unrelated OCII-plan block 33). The direct ucsf.edu article returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches in this pass; its content (matching $237,000,000 cost and 12-story/5-story/3-story massing figures already in this record) was confirmed via a search-engine summary rather than a direct read. A primary Regents PDF for the January 26, 2017 item itself was not located.

2026-09-22: the 'coincidental name collision' assumption above was reopened -- the owner directly identified OCII plan block 33 (data/records/ucsf_valley_center_for_vision_west.json, west of Illinois St, about 60-100m from this record's 490 Illinois St tower) as ALSO being Valley Center for Vision, not unrelated. Whether that west building is a second wing of this same facility, a distinct building sharing the name, or a misidentification, is unresolved -- see that record's own open_questions; not re-investigated here.
No opening date found for Caffe Central (490 Illinois St): checked its own site for a firm date; retail_confirmed.csv's own opened field is also blank, and the building itself only opened Nov 2020.

2026-09-28: exact month/day for 409 Illinois St's 2026 renovation start, and the exact date within 'late 2029' targeted for completion, are not given by any source found. Whether the Construction Dive-reported $278,000,000 figure is Suffolk's construction contract value alone or the total project cost (design, FF&E, etc.) is also not stated by that source. No SF Planning case number exists for this renovation because UC, as a state entity, is exempt from local planning review -- all environmental review runs through UC itself as CEQA lead agency; treat the absence of a Planning case number as confirmed, not unresearched. The Assessor's blklot for 499 Illinois St has been given as 3940001 (2006 permit), 3940004 (an earlier source in this file) and now 3940005 (a live 2026-09-28 query) -- not reconciled here; possibly repeated lot-line adjustments on a shared master parcel with 409 Illinois St, whose current blklot (3940003) is comparatively well-confirmed.

2026-09-29 accuracy audit: (a) OpenStreetMap tags way 84821715 as 499 Illinois St and way 84821722 as 490 Illinois St (both 6 levels, 28 m, source Yahoo), the opposite of this file's digitized_from; DataSF Parcels (acdm-wktn) list lots 3940003 (409 Illinois), 3940004 (499) and 3940005 (409-499) under mapblklot 3940003 and none addressed 490, so the shared mblr SF3940003 is a 409/499 pairing. Which mapped footprint is the 490 Illinois St Vision Center is unresolved; owner to decide (satellite check). (b) The UCSF news page for the January 2017 Regents approval could not be read (HTTP 403) and the Regents date is unconfirmed. (c) SF YIMBY (2020-11-27) shows the Vision Center open by that date but gives no opening date. (d) No source read says who developed 499 Illinois St, or that UCSF leased 'for over a decade'; SF Standard (2025-12-17) says UCSF leased space and occupied 90% of the building before buying it.
